policy.name: SYNTHETIC — fictional Summary of Benefits and Coverage

benefits.label: Referred specialist
conditions: If the participating primary provider omits the referral despite the member following instructions, the provider bears the denial and cannot bill the member; no patient cost sharing applies

clauses.text: What must I pay before benefits? The individual deductible is $1,000.00 in network and $2,000.00 out of network.
clauses.location: What must I pay before benefits?

clauses.text: Calculation and accumulation rules: For covered care apply any remaining deductible first, then the stated copay, then member coinsurance to the remaining allowed amount. Round coinsurance half up to cents. Apply the remaining annual OOP cap to deductible, copay and coinsurance in that order. Only actually assessed covered sharing accrues. In- and out-of-network annual pools are separate. Permitted excess equals charge minus allowance and is outside OOP. Excluded care is full-charge patient liability outside deductible and OOP, with no insurer payment. No excess billing is allowed in network. A waived deductible means no deductible applies to that benefit.
What is my annual limit? Covered sharing stops at $5,000.00 in network and $10,000.00 out of network.
B1: Referred specialist (CPT/HCPCS 99214), in-network: covered; deductible waived; member copay $50.00; member coinsurance 0%.

Special provisions: Specialist visits require a referral. If the participating primary provider omits it despite the member following instructions, the provider bears the denial and cannot bill the member; no patient cost sharing applies.
